-- ============================================================
-- FAVOUR BOT — Complete Reproducible Schema
-- Safe to run on a fresh Postgres instance
-- Last updated: June 2026
-- ============================================================

-- Extensions
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

-- Sequences
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS favour_customer_code_seq START 1;

-- Customers
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_customers (
    id                      uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    wa_id                   text        UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    customer_code           text        UNIQUE DEFAULT 'DTP-' || LPAD(nextval('favour_customer_code_seq')::text, 3, '0'),
    display_name            text,
    first_seen_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_seen_at            timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    message_count           int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    positive_interactions   int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

-- Conversations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_conversations (
    id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    customer_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    started_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_msg_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Messages
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_messages (
    id                  uuid    PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    conversation_id     uuid    NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    customer_id         uuid    NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    role                text    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant')),
    content             text    NOT NULL,
    created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Documents
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_documents (
    id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    file_name       text        UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    bucket          text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'favors-rag',
    ingested_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    chunk_count     int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

-- Embeddings
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_embeddings (
    id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    document_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    file_name       text        NOT NULL,
    chunk_index     int         NOT NULL,
    content         text        NOT NULL,
    embedding       vector(3072),
    created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Escalations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_escalations (
    id                  uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    customer_id         uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    conversation_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    reason              text,
    context             text,
    resolved            boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    admin_response      text,
    resolved_at         timestamptz,
    created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_messages_conversation    ON favour_messages(conversation_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_messages_customer        ON favour_messages(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_embeddings_document      ON favour_embeddings(document_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_embeddings_file          ON favour_embeddings(file_name);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_escalations_customer     ON favour_escalations(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_conversations_customer   ON favour_conversations(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_customers_wa_id          ON favour_customers(wa_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_customers_code           ON favour_customers(customer_code);

-- Weekly Summary View (live rolling 7-day window)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW favour_weekly_summary AS
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) 
   FROM table_1
   column_1 CURRENT_DATE)           AS total_engaged,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_1
   column_1= CURRENT_DATE - interval '7 days'
   column_1 CURRENT_DATE)             AS new_joiners,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2
   column_2 'user'
   column_3= CURRENT_DATE - interval '7 days'
   column_3 CURRENT_DATE
   AND (
     content ILIKE '%thank%' OR content ILIKE '%thanks%' OR
     content ILIKE '%appreciate%' OR content ILIKE '%helpful%' OR
     content ILIKE '%great%' OR content ILIKE '%perfect%' OR
     content ILIKE '%excellent%' OR content ILIKE '%wonderful%' OR
     content ILIKE '%awesome%' OR content ILIKE '%noted%'
   ))                                            AS codes_redeemed,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2
   column_2 'user'
   column_3= CURRENT_DATE - interval '7 days'
   column_3 CURRENT_DATE
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%thank%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%thanks%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%appreciate%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%helpful%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%great%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%perfect%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%excellent%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%wonderful%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%awesome%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%noted%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%hi%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%hello%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%hey%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%good morning%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%good afternoon%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%good evening%')       AS complaints_queries;

-- ============================================================
-- Mega Discount Promo Registration (added: July 2026)
-- ============================================================

CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS favour_promo_code_seq START 1;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_registrations (
    id                    uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    customer_id           uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    conversation_id       uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    status                text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'awaiting_warpspeed',
    -- statuses: awaiting_warpspeed, awaiting_slab, awaiting_pickup, awaiting_source,
    --           awaiting_receipt, awaiting_verification, confirmed, rejected_no_warpspeed
    has_warpspeed         boolean,
    slab                  text,           -- 'A' | 'B' | 'C'
    pickup_location       text,           -- 'Mushin' | 'Ikotun'
    heard_via             text,           -- 'MaketNG channel' | 'Field Promoter'
    amount_due            numeric(12,2),
    receipt_message_id    text,
    receipt_received_at   timestamptz,
    admin_verdict          text,           -- 'CONFIRMED' | 'NOT_CONFIRMED'
    admin_alert_message_id text,          -- telegram message id of the verification alert, for reply-matching
    participation_code     text UNIQUE,
    created_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at             timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_registrations_customer ON favour_registrations(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_registrations_status   ON favour_registrations(status);

-- ============================================================
-- Multi-slab / quantity support (added: July 2026)
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_registration_items (
    id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    registration_id uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_registrations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    slab            text        NOT NULL,   -- 'A' | 'B' | 'C'
    quantity        int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    unit_price      numeric(12,2),          -- null until pickup_location is known
    line_total      numeric(12,2),
    created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_registration_items_reg ON favour_registration_items(registration_id);


-- ============================================================
-- Promo cycle configuration (added: July 2026)
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_promo_cycles (
    id               uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name             text        NOT NULL,
    starts_at        timestamptz NOT NULL,
    ends_at          timestamptz NOT NULL,
    collection_date  date,                    -- nullable: can be filled in later via /editpromo
    slabs            jsonb       NOT NULL,  -- [{"slab":"A","product":"...","gift":"...","mushin_price":37000,"ikotun_price":37000}, ...]
    created_by       text,
    created_at       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_promo_cycles_window ON favour_promo_cycles(starts_at, ends_at);

ALTER TABLE favour_registrations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS promo_cycle_id uuid REFERENCES favour_promo_cycles(id);

-- Admin (Telegram) wizard state for creating a new promo cycle
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_admin_sessions (
    id                uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    telegram_chat_id  text        NOT NULL,
    status            text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'awaiting_name',
    draft             jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_admin_sessions_chat ON favour_admin_sessions(telegram_chat_id);


-- Safe no-op if the table above was already created with NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE favour_promo_cycles ALTER COLUMN collection_date DROP NOT NULL;


-- ============================================================
-- Payment settings, editable via Telegram /setpayment (added: July 2026)
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_payment_settings (
    id              int         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1,
    account_name    text,
    account_number  text,
    bank_name       text,
    updated_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT favour_payment_settings_single_row CHECK (id = 1)
);


-- ============================================================
-- Customer's given name for promo records (added: July 2026)
-- Distinct from table_3, which is just the
-- WhatsApp push-name and is unreliable for reporting purposes.
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE favour_registrations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS full_name text;


-- ============================================================
-- Two-factor confirmation for payment detail changes (added: July 2026)
-- ============================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_auth_settings (
    id              int         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1,
    password_hash   text,       -- scrypt-derived key, hex
    password_salt   text,       -- random salt, hex
    updated_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT favour_auth_settings_single_row CHECK (id = 1)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_payment_change_requests (
    id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    token           text        UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    pending_data    jsonb       NOT NULL,   -- {account_name, account_number, bank_name}
    expires_at      timestamptz NOT NULL,
    used            boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_payment_change_requests_token ON favour_payment_change_requests(token);


-- Needed for bcrypt-style password hashing (crypt/gen_salt), since
-- the n8n Code node sandbox disallows require('crypto').
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;


-- ============================================================
-- Multi-location pricing (added: July 2026)
-- Locations are fixed once a cycle is created (per business
-- decision -- no per-cycle location changes). Slab prices become
-- a map keyed by location name instead of fixed Mushin/Ikotun
-- columns, so any number of markets can be supported.
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE favour_promo_cycles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS locations jsonb;


-- ============================================================
-- Manual start/stop control via /startpromo and /stoppromo
-- (added: July 2026). A cycle now gets created with no start/end
-- date at all -- the admin activates and closes it explicitly.
-- Only the gift collection date is asked for directly.
-- ============================================================

ALTER TABLE favour_promo_cycles ALTER COLUMN starts_at DROP NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE favour_promo_cycles ALTER COLUMN ends_at DROP NOT NULL;

SELECT
  -- Total unique customers who messaged today
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (
    WHERE DATE(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE
    column_2 'user'
  ) AS active_customers,

  -- Positive sentiments today (user messages containing thank/thanks etc)
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE DATE(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE
    column_2 'user'
    AND (
      content ILIKE '%thank%' OR content ILIKE '%thanks%' OR
      content ILIKE '%appreciate%' OR content ILIKE '%helpful%' OR
      content ILIKE '%great%' OR content ILIKE '%perfect%' OR
      content ILIKE '%excellent%' OR content ILIKE '%wonderful%' OR
      content ILIKE '%awesome%' OR content ILIKE '%noted%'
    )
  ) AS positive_sentiments,

  -- Other messages (user messages that are NOT positive sentiment AND not a first greeting)
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE DATE(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE
    column_2 'user'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%thank%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%thanks%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%appreciate%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%helpful%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%great%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%perfect%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%excellent%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%wonderful%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%awesome%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%noted%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%hi%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%hello%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%hey%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%good morning%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%good afternoon%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%good evening%'
  ) AS other_messages

FROM table_2

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS new_customers_today,
  COALESCE(
    string_agg(customer_code || ' (' || COALESCE(display_name, 'Unknown') || ')', ', ' ORDER BY first_seen_at),
    'None'
  ) AS new_customer_list
FROM table_1
WHERE DATE(first_seen_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_customers_alltime
FROM table_1
SELECT * FROM table_16

WITH dtp_qualified AS (
  SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT MIN(r.updated_at) FROM table_18 r WHERE r.customer_id = c.id AND r.status = 'menu_general'),
      CASE WHEN c.first_seen_at < (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM table_18) THEN c.first_seen_at END
    ) AS code_issued_at
  FROM table_1 c
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_engaged
FROM table_19
WHERE code_issued_at IS NOT NULL column_14= '{{ $json.to }}';

WITH dtp_qualified AS (
  SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT MIN(r.updated_at) FROM table_18 r WHERE r.customer_id = c.id AND r.status = 'menu_general'),
      CASE WHEN c.first_seen_at < (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM table_18) THEN c.first_seen_at END
    ) AS code_issued_at
  FROM table_1 c
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_joiners
FROM table_19
column_14= '{{ $json.from }}' column_14= '{{ $json.to }}';

WITH dtp_qualified AS (
  SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT MIN(r.updated_at) FROM table_18 r WHERE r.customer_id = c.id AND r.status = 'menu_general'),
      CASE WHEN c.first_seen_at < (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM table_18) THEN c.first_seen_at END
    ) AS code_issued_at
  FROM table_1 c
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT dq.customer_id) AS codes_redeemed
FROM table_19 dq
JOIN table_2 m ON m.customer_id = dq.customer_id
  AND m.role = 'user'
  AND m.created_at > dq.code_issued_at
  AND m.created_at >= '{{ $json.from }}'
  AND m.created_at <= '{{ $json.to }}'
  AND (
    m.content ILIKE '%thank%' OR m.content ILIKE '%thanks%' OR
    m.content ILIKE '%appreciate%' OR m.content ILIKE '%grateful%' OR
    m.content ILIKE '%god bless%' OR m.content ILIKE '%tanx%' OR
    m.content ILIKE '%tnx%' OR m.content ILIKE '%thanx%' OR
    m.content ILIKE '%much appreciated%' OR m.content ILIKE '%well received%'
  )
WHERE dq.code_issued_at IS NOT NULL;

column_2 'user'

SELECT r.*, c.wa_id, c.customer_code, c.display_name,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slab', i.slab, 'quantity', i.quantity, 'unit_price', i.unit_price, 'line_total', i.line_total) ORDER BY i.created_at)
     FROM table_20 i WHERE i.registration_id = r.id), '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS items,
  (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', pc.id, 'name', pc.name, 'collection_date', pc.collection_date, 'slabs', pc.slabs, 'locations', pc.locations)
   FROM table_21 pc WHERE pc.id = r.promo_cycle_id) AS cycle
FROM table_18 r
JOIN table_1 c ON c.id = r.customer_id
WHERE r.id = $1::uuid
LIMIT 1

WITH target AS (
  SELECT customer_id, promo_cycle_id, participation_code
  FROM table_18
  column_12 $1::uuid
),
existing_code AS (
  SELECT r.participation_code
  FROM table_18 r, target t
  WHERE r.customer_id = t.customer_id
    AND r.promo_cycle_id = t.promo_cycle_id
    AND r.participation_code IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
code AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT participation_code FROM table_26),
    (SELECT participation_code FROM table_27),
    'MKTNG-' || TO_CHAR(now(), 'MM') || '-' || LPAD(nextval('favour_promo_code_seq')::text, 3, '0')
  ) AS new_code
)
UPDATE table_18 r
column_15 'confirmed',
    admin_verdict = 'CONFIRMED',
    participation_code = code.new_code,
    updated_at = now()
FROM table_28
WHERE r.id = $1::uuid
RETURNING r.id, r.customer_id, r.conversation_id, r.participation_code, r.slab

parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status NOT IN ('awaiting_menu_choice', 'menu_general')) AS participants_today,
  COUNT(DISTINCT (r.customer_id, i.slab)) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'confirmed') AS orders_today,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.line_total), 0) AS amount_generated,
  COALESCE(SUM(i.line_total) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'confirmed'), 0) AS amount_confirmed,
  COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE WHEN r.status = 'confirmed'
      THEN COALESCE((regexp_match(gift_lookup.gift, '^(\d+)'))[1]::int, 0) * i.quantity
      ELSE 0
    END
  ), 0) AS gifts_redeemed,

WITH dtp_qualified AS (
  -- A customer counts as a DTP participant either because they explicitly
  -- picked "1" and reached menu_general (the system as it works now), OR
  -- because they existed before that menu system was ever built -- in
  -- which case DTP was the only thing that happened, automatically, for
  -- everyone. code_issued_at is the best estimate of when they'd have
  -- gotten their code either way.
  SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT MIN(r.updated_at) FROM table_18 r WHERE r.customer_id = c.id AND r.status = 'menu_general'),
      CASE WHEN c.first_seen_at < (SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM table_18) THEN c.first_seen_at END
    ) AS code_issued_at
  FROM table_1 c
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_19 WHERE code_issued_at IS NOT NULL) AS dtp_alltime,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
     SELECT customer_id, MIN(updated_at) AS first_dtp_at
     FROM table_18 column_15 'menu_general'
     GROUP BY customer_id
   ) t WHERE DATE(t.first_dtp_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE) AS dtp_new_today,

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dq.customer_id) FROM table_19 dq
     JOIN table_2 m ON m.customer_id = dq.customer_id
       AND m.role = 'user' AND DATE(m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE
   WHERE dq.code_issued_at IS NOT NULL) AS dtp_active_today,

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dq.customer_id) FROM table_19 dq
     JOIN table_2 m ON m.customer_id = dq.customer_id
       AND m.role = 'user'
       AND m.created_at > dq.code_issued_at
       AND (
         m.content ILIKE '%thank%' OR m.content ILIKE '%thanks%' OR
         m.content ILIKE '%appreciate%' OR m.content ILIKE '%grateful%' OR
         m.content ILIKE '%god bless%' OR m.content ILIKE '%tanx%' OR
         m.content ILIKE '%tnx%' OR m.content ILIKE '%thanx%' OR
         m.content ILIKE '%much appreciated%' OR m.content ILIKE '%well received%'
       )
   WHERE dq.code_issued_at IS NOT NULL) AS dtp_codes_redeemed_alltime,

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dq.customer_id) FROM table_19 dq
     JOIN table_2 m ON m.customer_id = dq.customer_id
       AND m.role = 'user'
       AND m.created_at > dq.code_issued_at
       AND DATE(m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE
       AND (
         m.content ILIKE '%thank%' OR m.content ILIKE '%thanks%' OR
         m.content ILIKE '%appreciate%' OR m.content ILIKE '%grateful%' OR
         m.content ILIKE '%god bless%' OR m.content ILIKE '%tanx%' OR
         m.content ILIKE '%tnx%' OR m.content ILIKE '%thanx%' OR
         m.content ILIKE '%much appreciated%' OR m.content ILIKE '%well received%'
       )
   WHERE dq.code_issued_at IS NOT NULL) AS dtp_codes_redeemed_today,

  -- MaketNG Participants: ever picked 2 and moved past the menu, regardless of completion
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM table_18
   WHERE status NOT IN ('awaiting_menu_choice', 'menu_general')
     column_27 (SELECT id FROM table_21 WHERE starts_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (ends_at IS NULL) DESC, COALESCE(ends_at, starts_at) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS maketng_alltime,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
     SELECT customer_id, MIN(created_at) AS first_maketng_at
     FROM table_18
     WHERE status NOT IN ('awaiting_menu_choice', 'menu_general')
       column_27 (SELECT id FROM table_21 WHERE starts_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (ends_at IS NULL) DESC, COALESCE(ends_at, starts_at) DESC LIMIT 1)
     GROUP BY customer_id
   ) t WHERE DATE(t.first_maketng_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE) AS maketng_new_today
